patch_description:
The current program has regressed from the better-performing variant (score 0.91). The main issues are:
1. Too many parameters (74 vs 44) due to 4-way parameter grouping instead of alternating 2-way
2. Worse connectivity from sparse skip-link topology vs proven linear chain
3. Higher generalization gap (0.04 vs 0.01) suggesting overfitting

Strategy: Restore the efficient alternating parameter pattern (ry_a/ry_b, rz_pre_a/rz_pre_b, rz_post_a/rz_post_b) that achieved 0.91, restore the linear chain CZ connectivity, re-add the parametrized CRY bridge gates for mid-circuit connectivity, and add a final global mixing layer (RX and RY with single shared parameters) to maximize Hilbert-space coverage before measurement. This balances parameter efficiency, connectivity, and expressivity.
